Consultant in Technical Services (Information and Communication Technology)

content_sections.heading: About RPCAU
content_sections.text: Dr. Rajendra Prasad Central Agricultural University is a central agricultural university at Pusa in Samastipur district, Bihar. This Consultant will work on the University's IT systems and digital services at Pusa.

rows.post: Consultant in Technical Services (Information and Communication Technology)

content_sections.heading: RPCAU Consultant (IT) Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Master's Degree in the relevant subject. Candidates need experience in the field directly relevant to the University target group, along with experience in one or more of these areas: Website and portal development and management, including ASP.NET, Java, PHP, Oracle, MySQL, Web Services and related application development including dot net, server network and backup maintenance Database Administration, ERP, e-Office, e-HRMS and SAMARTH Portal IT project management, documentation and reporting Good knowledge of IT infrastructure and communication technology Good understanding of Windows systems, databases and cloud platforms Good understanding of cybersecurity, data privacy and information security Good communication and coordination skills Ability to work independently as well as with multidisciplinary teams Good problem-solving skills See the official notification for the full eligibility details of this post.

content_sections.heading: Scope of Work and Job Responsibilities
content_sections.text: Providing technical advice and strategic support on IT-related matters Planning, implementing and monitoring IT infrastructure and systems Managing networks, servers, databases, applications and cloud-based services Ensuring IT system security, data protection, backup and disaster-recovery arrangements Identifying and resolving technical issues and ensuring minimum downtime Supporting digital transformation and automation initiatives Preparing technical specifications, reports, proposals and IT-related documentation Coordinating with IT vendors, service providers and other stakeholders Monitoring compliance with applicable IT policies, standards and security requirements Performing any other IT-related duties assigned by the competent authority

rows.event: Last date for receipt of applications

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The hiring is initially for one year and may be extended as per the requirement and satisfactory performance of the Consultant. The engagement is purely temporary and on contract basis, and it will not confer any right for regular appointment in the University. The University reserves the right to terminate a contract without assigning any reasons. The University may cancel this notice and not proceed with the engagement at any stage. The University may accept or reject any or all applications without giving any explanation.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for RPCAU Consultant (IT) Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Prepare your application in the prescribed format. Attach self-attested supporting documents. Send the application by post to The Deputy Registrar (Rectt.), Recruitment Section, RPCAU, Pusa, Samastipur - 848125, Bihar. If you wish, send the same copy to [email protected] . Applications received after the due date and time, or without supporting documents, will not be considered.

faq.question: Q1. Is emailing the application enough for the RPCAU Consultant post?
faq.answer: The notice asks for the application by post. The email address [email protected] is given for sending the same copy as well.

faq.question: Q2. Which technical experience does RPCAU accept for this post?
faq.answer: You need experience in at least one listed area: web and portal development, database administration with ERP, e-Office, e-HRMS and SAMARTH Portal, or IT project management, documentation and reporting.

faq.question: Q3. Is this a permanent job at RPCAU?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is purely temporary and on contract basis, and it gives no right to a regular appointment in the University.

faq.question: Q4. Can the one-year contract be extended?
faq.answer: Yes, it may be extended depending on the University's requirement and the Consultant's satisfactory performance.

faq.question: Q5. What will the Consultant (IT) do at RPCAU?
faq.answer: The work includes managing networks, servers, databases, applications and cloud-based services, along with IT security, backup and disaster-recovery arrangements.

faq.question: Q6. What kind of work background is the University looking for?
faq.answer: The notice invites eligible candidates with good work experience under Government, State Government or PSUs.

faq.question: Q7. Will an application without documents be accepted?
faq.answer: No. Applications without supporting documents will not be considered, and the documents must be self-attested.
